## How the lanes were reconstructed

Lanes are threaded from the **study-key ranges**, which do not overlap
(A: S1–S45 · B: S97–S114 · C: S66, T1–T21, S13x). Two earlier rules failed and are
recorded in the indexer's docstring: reading the lane off the title mislabelled ten
sections, and threading by section-number adjacency split a lane that is known to be
contiguous. The indexer asserts that **study numbers are monotone within a lane**;
that assert is what caught both failures.

**11 of 99 rows carry no study key in their title** and were attached by line
adjacency. They are marked `~` below and are the lower-confidence rows.
